Based in [[New Delhi]], the company offers tests on blood, urine and other human body [[Organ (anatomy)|viscera]].{{Citation needed|date=May 2022}} == History == Dr Lal PathLabs was started in 1949, by the late S. K. Lal.{{cite news |title=US PE firm in talks to buy 15% in Dr Lal PathLabs from Sequoia |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/industry/healthcare/biotech/healthcare/us-pe-firm-in-talks-to-buy-15-in-dr-lal-pathlabs-from-sequoia/articleshow/6316861.cms |access-date=22 October 2021 |work=The Economic Times}}{{Cite web|title = Dr Lal PathLabs|url = https://www.ibef.org/industry/healthcare-india/showcase/dr-lal-pathlabs|publisher = [[India Brand Equity Foundation]]|access-date = 8 February 2016}} Lal was a Junior Doctor in the [[British Indian Army]] and studied pathology from the [[Armed Forces Medical College (India)|Armed Forces Medical College]] in [[Pune]], with additional training in pathology at [[John H. Stroger, Jr. Hospital of Cook County|Cook County Hospital]] in [[Chicago]].{{cite news |last1=Phadnis |first1=Aneesh |title=Country's oldest path lab chain to go public with Rs 638-cr IPO |url=https://www.business-standard.com/article/markets/country-s-oldest-path-lab-chain-to-go-public-with-rs-638-crore-ipo-115113000846_1.html |access-date=22 October 2021 |work=Business Standard India |date=1 December 2015}} The main operation of Dr Lal PathLabs deals with the performing of diagnosis and testing, including routine tests (including blood tests), specialized tests (e.g., viral and [[bacterial]] [[infection]] tests) and preventive screenings.{{Citation needed|date=May 2022}} In 2014, Dr Lal PathLabs acquired the APL Clinical Institute of Clinical Laboratory & Research Private Limited.{{Cite web|title = Dr Lal Pathlabs Ltd.|url = https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/dr.-lal-pathlabs-ltd/infocompanyhistory/companyid-63225.cms|website = The Times of India|access-date = 8 February 2016}} Dr Lal PathLabs launched its IPO in 2015.{{cite news |title=Dr Lal Pathlabs IPO To Open On Dec 8, Price Band Rs 540-550 |language=en |work=Moneycontrol |url=https://www.moneycontrol.com/news/business/ipo/dr-lal-pathlabs-ipo-to-opendec-8-price-band-rs-540-550-1506619.html |access-date=22 October 2021}} The company got listed on BSE and NSE on 23 December 2015.{{cite web |last1=Mudgill |first1=Amit |date=23 December 2015 |title=PathLabs, Alkem soar on stock market debut |url=http://articles.economictimes.indiatimes.com/2015-12-23/news/69261288_1_issue-price-dr-lal-pathlabs-anchor-investors |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20151229132351/http://articles.economictimes.indiatimes.com/2015-12-23/news/69261288_1_issue-price-dr-lal-pathlabs-anchor-investors |url-status=dead |archive-date=29 December 2015 |access-date=2 February 2016 |website=The Economic Times}} In 2021, Dr Lal PathLabs acquired Suburban Diagnostics for an [[enterprise value]] of {{INR}}925 crore in an all-cash deal.{{cite news |title=Dr Lal Path Labs buys Suburban Diagnostics in all-cash deal |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/tech/startups/dr-lal-path-labs-buys-suburban-diagnostics-in-all-cash-deal/articleshow/87287858.cms |access-date=13 January 2023 |work=The Economic Times}} ==Operations== === Infrastructure === The company has 200 laboratories and diagnostic centres with approximately 5000+ collection centres across India. They have also worked with BD India to open a "Centre of Excellence in Phlebotomy", a centre for training healthcare in the process of safely collecting blood samples.{{Cite web |date=8 July 2015 |title=BD India and Dr Lal PathLabs launch COE in phlebotomy |url=https://www.financialexpress.com/article/healthcare/market/bd-india-and-dr-lal-pathlabs-launch-coe-in-phlebotomy-2/97294/ |access-date=10 February 2016 |website=The Financial Express}} === Laboratory Accreditations === *[[ISO 9001:2008]] certification from [[British Standards Institution]] (BSI){{Cite web |title=Organisers & Partners |url=http://eindia.eletsonline.com/2013/Hyderabad/partners/ |access-date=14 February 2016 |website=eletsonline.com}} *[[National Accreditation Board for Testing and Calibration Laboratories]] (NABL), Ministry of Science and Technology, [[Government of India]].{{Cite web |title=DIRECTORY of ACCREDITED MEDICAL TESTING LABORATORIES |url=http://www.nabl-india.org/nabl/file_download.php?filename=201503030338-NABL-600-doc.pdf. |access-date=14 February 2016 |website=nabl-india.org}} == Awards and recognition == *The [[CNBC TV18]] Emerging Company of the Year award in 2008{{Cite web |title=Cnbc Tv18 Emerging India Award |url=http://www.moneycontrol.com/news-topic/cnbc-tv18-emerging-india-award/40 |access-date=14 February 2016 |website=moneycontrol.com}} *The Best Diagnostic Service Company in India at [[VCCircle]] Healthcare summit 2013.{{Cite web |title=Take a look at winners of VCCircle Healthcare Awards 2013 |url=http://www.vccircle.com/news/health-care/2013/10/01/take-look-winners-vccircle-healthcare-awards-2013 |access-date=14 February 2016 |website=VCCircle}} *Diagnostic Service Provider Company of the Year 2012 by [[Frost & Sullivan]].{{Cite web |title=FROST & SULLIVAN 4th ANNUAL INDIA HEALTHCARE EXCELLENCE AWARDS 2012 |url=http://www.frost.com/prod/servlet/cpo/265030858 |access-date=14 February 2016 |website=frost.com}} *Award for Service Excellence (Diagnostic Centre) for the Year 2018 by [[Federation of Indian Chambers of Commerce & Industry]]{{Cite web |title=FICCI Healthawards 2018 |url=https://www.ficcihealthawards.com/past-winners.php |access-date=2019-01-31 |website=www.ficcihealthawards.com}} == Controversies == === Zika outbreak === While [[Zika virus|Zika]] has not been reported in India (as of 6 February 2016), on 3 February 2016, Dr Lal PathLabs and other competing [https://diagnear.com/ pathology labs] announced they were preparing Zika test kits.{{Cite web|title = In India, Zika detection test to hit market by March, cost pegged at Rs 5,000|url = https://www.hindustantimes.com/business/in-india-zika-detection-test-to-hit-market-by-march-cost-pegged-at-rs-5-000himani-chandna/story-vuNMNuZgkHwGJ2jACML7JN.html|website = Hindustan Times| date=3 February 2016 |access-date = 10 February 2016}} Dr Lal PathLabs reported they plan to sell their kits for Rs 4500 (€60). However, several days later IndiaToday reported: "the Union Ministry of Health pulled up private players, saying they cannot cash in on a public health emergency" and also reported that Dr. Vandana Lal (executive director of Dr Lal PathLabs) stated: "We don't want to talk on this matter. We don't have any tests for Zika virus and we are also not importing any test kits for the same. If at all we plan to do something, we will take the government's prior permission."{{Cite web|title = Health Ministry pulls up laboratories for trying to cash in on Zika scare|url = https://www.indiatoday.in/mail-today/story/health-ministry-pulls-up-labs-for-trying-to-cash-in-on-zika-scare-307393-2016-02-05|website = India Today|access-date = 10 February 2016}} === Data breach === According to an October 2020 report, for months, the company stored hundreds of massive spreadsheets containing sensitive patient data in an [[Amazon Web Services]] storage bucket without a password. [[TechCrunch]] was the first news source to report the data breach.{{Cite web |date=2020-10-10 |title=Dr Lal PathLabs leaks millions of patients data in public domain: Report |url=https://indianexpress.com/article/technology/tech-news-technology/lalpath-labs-leaked-data-millions-patients-in-public-6716966/ |access-date=2022-05-19 |website=The Indian Express |language=en}}{{Cite web |last=Ahaskar |first=Leroy Leo, Abhijit |date=2020-10-08 |title=Dr Lal PathLabs left critical patient data exposed on public server |url=https://www.livemint.com/companies/news/dr-lal-pathlabs-exposed-patient-data-on-public-server-for-months-report-11602162932403.html |access-date=2022-05-19 |website=mint |language=en}} == References == {{reflist|colwidth=30em}} == External links == * {{Official website|https://www.lalpathlabs.com/}} {{Nifty 200 companies}} [[Category:Health care companies of India]] [[Category:Laboratories in India]] [[Category:Indian companies established in 1949]] [[Category:Companies based in Delhi]] [[Category:Companies listed on the National Stock Exchange of India]] [[Category:Companies listed on the Bombay Stock Exchange]]
